CREATE TABLE "public"."Scalars" (
  "id" int4 NOT NULL,
  "tsZ" timestamp(3) DEFAULT ('2024-01-02 03:04:05') NOT NULL,
  "tsMs" timestamp(3) DEFAULT ('2024-01-02 03:04:05.123') NOT NULL,
  "tsPlus" timestamp(3) DEFAULT ('2024-01-02 03:04:05') NOT NULL,
  "tsMinus" timestamp(3) DEFAULT ('2024-01-02 23:04:05') NOT NULL,
  "tsMicro" timestamp(6) DEFAULT ('2024-01-02 03:04:05.123456') NOT NULL,
  "tzZ" timestamptz(6) DEFAULT ('2024-01-02 03:04:05+00') NOT NULL,
  "tzPlus" timestamptz(6) DEFAULT ('2024-01-02 01:04:05+00') NOT NULL,
  "dZ" date DEFAULT ('2024-01-02') NOT NULL,
  "dMidnight" date DEFAULT ('2024-01-02') NOT NULL,
  "dMinus" date DEFAULT ('2024-01-02') NOT NULL,
  "tZ" time(6) DEFAULT ('12:34:56') NOT NULL,
  "tMs" time(6) DEFAULT ('12:34:56.789') NOT NULL,
  "tPlus" time(6) DEFAULT ('03:04:05') NOT NULL,
  "ttzZ" timetz(6) DEFAULT ('12:34:56+00') NOT NULL,
  "ttzPlus" timetz(6) DEFAULT ('03:04:05+02') NOT NULL,
  "bytes" bytea DEFAULT ('\x68656c6c6f') NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)
